claims.citation: New York Herald, 16 May 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Ship Cultivator, Russell, Liverpool March 23[?], with mdse
and 52 passengers, to Williams & Guion. March 23, in St
Georges Channel, experienced a severe equinoctial gale, dur
ing which shifted cargo; was 11 days getting to Cape Clear;
has had strong westerly gales, with intervening calms; April
23, lat 39 27, lon 43 30, spoke brig Velocity (Br), bound W;
May 7, 3 PM, lat 41 20, lon 62 50, passed a Hamburg steamer.
bound E.

pass. to Williams & Guion.
